description: Finds public events listed on Zonori in a place within the next 7 days, by activity (a circle's name or category, e.g. yoga, running, board games) and local days. Returns the same fields as whats_on.

activity.description: Part of an activity's name or category, e.g. yoga

place.description: A place's name or slug from list_places, e.g. Bangkok or bangkok

to.description: Last local day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days on)

name: find_events
title: Find events
